findings.summary: Cost filter uses api_name strings ('black-forest-labs/flux-kontext-pro') that never match the input data model field ('Flux Kontext Pro'), causing zero cost charges for this block.
findings.failure_scenario: User runs AIImageEditorBlock with model=FluxKontextModelName.PRO (string value 'Flux Kontext Pro'). The cost filter has 'model': 'black-forest-labs/flux-kontext-pro'. The _is_cost_filter_match in executor/utils.py compares these strings for equality -- they never match. The block_usage_cost function returns (0, {}), so no credits are deducted regardless of which model is used.
